value.rationale: A complete sharp classification on the natural first nonsquarefree prime-exponent family, spanning arbitrary prime-power exponent and arbitrary distinct squarefree cofactor. It isolates the exceptional one-prime cofactor tower and proves exact stabilization for every additional factor. The output is a uniform arithmetic invariant, not finite numerology or a mere restatement of the published generating function.
